response.justification: Bogdan has over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience and an entrepreneurial background as a founder, fulfilling the minimum experience and technical degree requirements. However, the candidate lacks the director-level strategic leadership experience and deep, recognized AI/Machine Learning expertise required for this Principal AI Strategy role. His background is primarily as a Senior/Staff Full-Stack Developer rather than an enterprise AI strategist or cloud AI platform leader.
strengths: Over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience across full-stack, infrastructure, and embedded systems.
Entrepreneurial experience as the founder of GISCollective, demonstrating end-to-end product development.
Strong history of technical evangelism and mentorship through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks the required Director-level technical leadership and strategic enterprise advisory experience.
Missing deep, recognized expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with only minor recent exposure.
Does not possess the preferred Master's or PhD degree in an AI-related field.
